Policy Name: Cigna Lumbar Fusion (CMM-609: Lumbar Fusion with Decompression)

Required findings: Non‑fixed spinal deformity requiring 5°‑10° of correction per segment (Smith‑Peterson or Ponte osteotomy).

Either lumbar sagittal plane deformity with sagittal vertical axis (SVA) > 8 cm OR pelvic incidence‑lumbar lordosis mismatch (PI‑LL) > 15°, OR a larger coronal deformity with limited flexibility and Cobb angle > 30°.
Maximum of four (4) posterior column osteotomies performed at the apex of the deformity in the same correction surgery (unless the patient has Scheuermann’s kyphosis, for which no limit applies).
Procedure must be performed in conjunction with fusion and meet the criteria of the applicable procedure‑specific sections (e.g., CMM‑609.3 through CMM‑609.8).
Fixed sagittal plane deformity that requires > 30° of correction (pedicle subtraction osteotomy).
OR a large, fixed coronal deformity > 60° that is amenable to an asymmetric osteotomy (vertebral column resection).
Procedure must be performed in conjunction with fusion and meet the criteria of the applicable procedure‑specific sections (e.g., CMM‑609.3 through CMM‑609.8).

Non-Indications: Deformities that are fixed but require less than 5°‑10° correction per segment for a PCO.
Sagittal deformities with SVA ≤ 8 cm and PI‑LL ≤ 15°, or coronal deformities with Cobb angle ≤ 30°, when requesting a PCO.
Fixed sagittal deformities requiring ≤ 30° correction or fixed coronal deformities ≤ 60° when requesting a three‑column osteotomy.
More than four posterior column osteotomies performed in the same correction surgery for non‑Scheuermann’s kyphosis patients.
Performing an osteotomy without an accompanying fusion procedure.
Requests that do not fall within any of the listed applicable procedure‑specific sections (CMM‑609.3‑CMM‑609.8).
Important criteria & exceptions: Maximum of four (4) posterior column osteotomies per correction surgery, except for Scheuermann’s kyphosis where the limit does not apply.
All osteotomies must be performed in addition to a fusion procedure.
The specific osteotomy criteria must be satisfied within one of the applicable procedure‑specific sections (CMM‑609.3‑CMM‑609.8).
Documentation required: Standing lateral full‑spine radiograph measuring sagittal vertical axis (SVA).
Standing lateral radiograph measuring pelvic incidence and lumbar lordosis to calculate PI‑LL mismatch.
Standing anteroposterior (AP) radiograph measuring Cobb angle for coronal deformity.
Flexibility assessment (e.g., supine‑to‑standing or side‑bending radiographs) to demonstrate limited flexibility for coronal deformities.
Operative report confirming osteotomy type (PCO or PSO/VCR), number of posterior column osteotomies performed, and that fusion was performed concurrently.
Diagnosis documentation confirming presence or absence of Scheuermann’s kyphosis (if applicable).
Reference to the specific applicable procedure‑specific section (e.g., CMM‑609.4 Lumbar Fusion with Decompression) supporting the indication.
